parameters.label: Flit and AXI data width
parameters.description: RaveNoC uses one width for NoC flits and AXI data

parameters.label: Virtual-channel buffer depth
parameters.description: Flits stored by every virtual-channel FIFO; must be a power of two

parameters.label: Virtual channels
parameters.description: Independent wormhole flow-control channels per router port

parameters.label: Routing order
parameters.description: Dimension-order routing used by the RaveNoC router

parameters.label: Maximum packet length
parameters.description: Maximum packet size accepted by the network interface

parameters.label: Enable AXI clock-domain crossing
parameters.description: Instantiate the vendor asynchronous FIFO between every AXI interface and the NoC clock
